coordinate_contract.mapping: top-left origin, x-right, y-down, source pixels
coordinate_contract.manifest: canvas-centred origin, x-right, y-down, source pixels
coordinate_contract.registration: local_pivot_xy is component-local; bind_pivot_source_xy places that registration on the assembled source canvas. Legacy entries register the crop geometric centre at center_source_xy.
coordinate_contract.child_joint: local_child_joint_xy is transformed around local_pivot_xy and retained as endpoint metadata
coordinate_contract.rotation: rotation_deg is baked clockwise in source/image space around the attachment registration

reference_setup_anchors.policy: reuse only Root and otherwise unmapped attachment-free control bone pivots; never reuse legacy part textures
